relations.subject: Sukumar Sen
relations.evidence: Sen was educated at the Burdwan Municipal High School, Burdwan, 1917.

relations.subject: Sukumar Sen
relations.evidence: He obtained an F.A. in 1919 from Burdwan Raj College, then affiliated with the University of Calcutta.

relations.subject: Sukumar Sen
relations.evidence: He received a divisional scholarship and earned first class honours in Sanskrit from the Government Sanskrit College in 1921.

relations.subject: Sukumar Sen
relations.evidence: Linguists Suniti Kumar Chatterji and Irach Jehangir Sorabji Taraporewala were his teachers.
